description: Gaussian propagation and thin-lens focusing from Siegman, Lasers (1986), with ISO 11146 beam propagation ratio. Returns Rayleigh range, radius, curvature, Gaussian-model Gouy phase, half-angle divergence, focused waist, depth of focus and peak intensity; phase and intensity for M^2 > 1 are Gaussian estimates.

title: Gaussian beam calculator
